reasons: Decision path is observation-only: tools/context.py:build parses only obs text (message:, language observation:, cursor (x=,y=), map: block); no env/unwrapped/full_state/seed/task-id access anywhere in agent.py or tools/*.py (grep-confirmed).

FieldStage (tools/stages.py:131-178) + Chart (tools/field.py) descend a visit-weighted Dijkstra field built from glyphs the agent has SEEN (drawn '>' or frontier of observed cells); the refusal ledger is fed by the agent's own previous position/action and the message line — legitimate perception/memory, not oracle.

No hardcoding: no lookup tables keyed on episode/seed/task; the only per-task switch is re-parsing the legal action vocabulary when the system prompt changes (agent.py:_sync_legal), which is observation of the prompt.

No scorer exploitation: the harness only returns an action string via _Resp; it never touches env.step, success flags, or result files. Short-circuited steps return input/output_tokens=0 honestly because no model call happened.

Traces are consistent with the code: across all 8 tasks the CSV Reasoning column shows 1666 'field:*' steps, 573 'model:*' steps and 64 'modal->more' steps, matching the claimed pipeline (field owns movement, model only on flat field); model-skipped steps are labelled as such, not faked as llm calls.
The large model-free share is a harness-design choice (code owning movement), not a cheat; it reflects the mechanism rather than privileged information.
